about: Generated by tools/design_system.py build. Do not edit.

components.name: FxCaustics
components.subtitle: Light through water behind a headline: flow ink on the surface, still under reduced motion
components.summary: FxCaustics is light through moving water (ported from Subframe Motion "Tidal caustics"), a faint flow-coloured web drifting on the host's own ground; the home hero's ambient layer.

components.name: FxContour
components.subtitle: Survey-sheet contour lines on limestone, under a coverage map
components.summary: FxContour is contour lines of a slowly drifting terrain (ported from Subframe Motion "Contour terrain"), drawn as hairlines with an index contour every fifth, so a map sheet reads as a survey sheet.

components.name: FxCutaway
components.subtitle: RO element body cut away behind its drawn feed end
components.summary: FxCutaway is the body of the RO element behind MembraneFace's drawn end face, a quarter cut away to show the wound leaves (ported from Subframe Motion "Kiln section": a ray-marched solid with shaded cut faces).

components.name: FxGuilloche
components.subtitle: Engraved rosette on the navy certificate tile
components.summary: FxGuilloche is an engraved certificate rosette (ported from Subframe Motion "Guilloché"): rings modulated by two petal waves turning very slowly, in on-navy hairlines on a navy tile.

components.name: FxPhosphor
components.subtitle: Phosphor glow under the trend reading on the dark panel
components.summary: FxPhosphor is the glow of a phosphor screen under a drawn reading (ported from Subframe Motion "Phosphor trace"): a halo, a ghost and a slow sweep in flow, following HmiTrend's own trace exactly.

components.name: FxRipple
components.subtitle: Navy closing band whose surface ripples under the pointer
components.summary: FxRipple is a water surface that remembers the pointer (ported from Subframe Motion "Ripple memory"): a small wave simulation whose glints trail the pointer across a navy band and fade in about two seconds.

components.name: FxShader
components.subtitle: Ambient WebGL layer behind a navy band: drawn from the tokens, still under reduced motion
components.summary: FxShader is an ambient WebGL layer (a water surface, a flow field, guilloché, contours) drawn behind one section's content from the design tokens; use it for the one material moment on a page.

components.name: FxTruchet
components.subtitle: Twin-wall pipe tiles drifting on a limestone band
components.summary: FxTruchet is a ground of twin-wall pipe tiles (ported from Subframe Motion "Truchet ribbon"): quarter-arc tiles that join into endless pipework, drifting slowly sideways, faint on limestone.

components.name: Icon
components.subtitle: 24 line-art spots in list rows
components.summary: Icon is a small line icon of one piece of water-system equipment, a document or a task, painted with a colour token, that lets a list row be recognised before it is read.

components.name: Illustration
components.subtitle: Equipment line art painted with a token
components.summary: Illustration shows an isometric line drawing of Aquemi equipment, painted with a colour token so the same file works in light and dark themes.

components.name: IsoKit
components.subtitle: Isometric line-drawing kit: every part, a pretreatment-to-point-of-use scene with its water path, and the navy ground
components.summary: IsoKit is the shared isometric line-drawing kit: equipment, pipes, water flow, dimensions, leaders and drawing-sheet furniture in fine 1.5 px technical line art, so every section that draws a system reads as drawn by one hand.

components.name: Page
components.subtitle: Section, container and type classes
components.summary: Page is the layout every Aquemi page, section and preview sits in: the container, the section rhythm and the type classes.

components.name: Placeholder
components.subtitle: Highlighted and clean
components.summary: Placeholder marks a fact only Aquemi can supply (a capacity, lead time, certificate, location, case-study figure) so an invented number never ships.

components.name: SplitSection
components.subtitle: Heading column left, content right
components.summary: SplitSection puts a section's heading in a sticky left column and its content on the right, so long pages alternate between full-width and two-column rhythm instead of stacking heading, text, heading, text.

components.name: Spot
components.subtitle: Equipment vignettes at 96, 128 and 160 px, in ink and ink-muted, on surface and on a plate
components.summary: Spot draws one icon from the Icon set larger, as the figure for a stop on a route, a stage of a process diagram, an option module or a zone of a plant map.

components.name: Button
components.subtitle: Primary, secondary, link and disabled; a call whose number is still a placeholder
components.summary: Buttons start an action or move someone to the next step of an enquiry.

components.name: BackToTop
components.subtitle: Floating button, shown once the reader is well down a page; arrow only on phones
components.summary: BackToTop is a quiet floating button that returns the reader to the top of a long page once they are well down it.

components.name: Footer
components.subtitle: Site footer on navy: Limestone logo, description and contact line, four sitemap columns, legal line
components.summary: Footer closes every page on navy: the Limestone logo with one line of description and the contact line, four sitemap columns, and the legal line.

components.name: NavBar
components.subtitle: Desktop header with the service link; phone menu with the urgent block and section jump
components.summary: The site header: logo, primary sections, a "Service request" link and one call to action.

components.name: SectionNav
components.subtitle: Numbered jump links and page progress on a system page
components.summary: SectionNav is a sticky bar of numbered jump links to the sections of a long technical page, with a quiet page progress readout.

components.name: ApprovalMerge
components.subtitle: Who prepares each request, lanes merging into one approval
components.summary: ApprovalMerge shows who prepares and who approves each request as lanes that merge into one approval: each request large on the left, its preparer a node on that party's lane, a wire from every node into one bus that ends in a single stamp naming the approver.

components.name: Band
components.subtitle: Statement band on limestone, and on sunken with an optional mark
components.summary: Band sets one short statement large on a quiet limestone or sunken ground, with a supporting line and a faint pipework line drawing at the right; its ground modifiers (`aq-band--limestone`, `aq-band--sunken`, `aq-band--navy`) also change the ground for other sections.

components.name: BatteryLimit
components.subtitle: Site requirements on a navy and limestone split; the divide is the battery limit, every card tied to it by a leader
components.summary: BatteryLimit lays site requirements on a navy and limestone split whose divide is the battery limit, so the reader sees each requirement as a connection point on the line between the package and their site.

components.name: BinderSpines
components.subtitle: Five inspectors as ring binders on the QA shelf: the clause each cites, what they read, where we answer it
components.summary: BinderSpines sets an evidence table (who inspects, what they read, where we answer it) as ring binders standing on a QA shelf, one binder per inspector, the clause each one cites set large on its spine.

components.name: BudgetBento
components.subtitle: Budget ranges as a Swiss bento: the whole package as the navy lead tile, three modules beside it, what moves the price and what is excluded as chips
components.summary: BudgetBento sets budget ranges as a Swiss bento of numbered tiles, the whole package as a tall navy lead tile and each module beside it, so a range reads as a price sheet with its scope and basis rather than as a table row.

components.name: CapaRing
components.subtitle: NCR to CAPA close as one ring that closes, navy ground
components.summary: CapaRing shows a closed-loop procedure (a defect held, decided, repaired, corrected, checked and reported) as steps around one ring that the water runs once and closes, the hold step drawn as a closed valve.

components.name: CaseStudy
components.subtitle: Fact rows and outcome figure; second awaits its figure; third is a template with status, profile and method; fourth is a project record (drawing, outcomes, timeline)
components.summary: CaseStudy summarizes a delivered project as hairline fact rows (client, problem, system delivered) beside one large measured-outcome figure on a quiet panel.

components.name: CertSeals
components.subtitle: Certification status as sealed certificate tiles
components.summary: CertSeals sets certification status as a Swiss row of certificate tiles: a seal (ring of ticks round the item's line icon), the standard or mark it is held to set large and light, what it covers and its status.

components.name: CheckLedger
components.subtitle: Six checks before a case study: what each shows, the route, what it does not prove
components.summary: CheckLedger sets a router table of checks a buyer can run before a case study exists as a two-sided ledger on a navy band: what each check lets you see on the left, what it does not prove on the right, and the route to arrange it on the seam between them.

components.name: ClauseCrosswalk
components.subtitle: Requirements wired to two regulations' clauses: editorial crosswalk with vertical spines
components.summary: ClauseCrosswalk sets a table of requirements against two regulations' clauses as an editorial crosswalk: the requirements large down the middle, each regulation a spine at the outer edge with its name set big and vertical and its clauses as chips, and a wire from every requirement to every clause it cites.

components.name: Closing
components.subtitle: Closing band: display headline on navy with the large faint mark cut by the corner, large Limestone button; the exchange drawn as send rows, a pipe with the turnaround and returned sheets
components.summary: Closing is the call to action at the end of every page: one centred display headline on the navy band, one lead sentence and a large primary button, with the brand mark large and faint, cut by the top-left corner.

components.name: Colophon
components.subtitle: Company facts as a measured editorial colophon
components.summary: Colophon sets a spec block of company facts as a measured editorial colophon: the one highlighted fact as a display-size statement, every other fact as a line on a measuring rule with its evidence as a margin note, so a company's facts read like the masthead of a well-made publication rather than a table.

components.name: ContactRoutes
components.subtitle: Three ways in as route sheets on a navy band: proposal (this page) and supplier audit on limestone, urgent service as the dark sheet with its call bar; each a numbered water rail ending at its response clock
components.summary: ContactRoutes deals the ways into Aquemi onto a navy band as route sheets, each showing what happens after you act as a numbered sequence on a water rail that ends at its response clock, so a buyer on a contact page sees which route fits and what follows before the form.

components.name: CostBalance
components.subtitle: Running costs as streams across a system boundary
components.summary: CostBalance draws what it costs to run a system as a balance around it: a dashed system boundary with the treatment train inside, every running cost a stream wired in from the left, the water that leaves (to drain) wired out to the right.

components.name: CoverageMap
components.subtitle: Can you support my site: a tile map of the provinces and territories held beside the region rows; a row lights its tiles
components.summary: CoverageMap reads a coverage table by region off a tile map: the provinces and territories as squares on a limestone sheet held in view, the regions as rows beside it, and the row you point at, focus or read lighting its tiles.

components.name: CutBand
components.subtitle: C&Q: alert and action levels on a navy band cutting across the plant
components.summary: CutBand lays a short table of levels across a hairline drawing of the plant as a full-width navy band, like a cutting plane (look `cut-band`, spec block).

components.name: CutawayRail
components.subtitle: GMP standards on a rail beside a sticky cutaway; the active card lights the parts it governs
components.summary: CutawayRail reads an evidence table beside one sticky drawing: a close isometric cutaway of the plant stays in view while one card per standard runs down a rail, and the card being read lights the parts it governs, with an "active" tag and a callout naming it.

components.name: CutoverSchedule
components.subtitle: An upgrade as a schedule, the water line broken only at cutover
components.summary: CutoverSchedule sets how an upgrade runs as a schedule: each step a row with its bar on one shared, not-to-scale timeline, a hold diamond where someone signs, and your system's water line above, broken only at the step that names a planned shutdown.

components.name: DecisionValve
components.subtitle: Chlorine or chloramine router as a multiport valve on paper
components.summary: DecisionValve draws a router table as a multiport valve, a navy object on the paper: supplies on the left, the valve with one numbered position per route in the middle, the routes as cards on the right; choosing a supply turns the lever to that position and lights the line in and the line out, while every card stays readable.

components.name: DerivationSheet
components.subtitle: Rinse water grade worked as numbered derivation lines, device endotoxin limits as hero figures
components.summary: DerivationSheet works a grade table as an engineering derivation on a calculation pad: each row is a numbered line read like an equation, step, what sets it, then the typical water boxed as the answer, with a device limit set as the line's hero figure.

components.name: DocHotspots
components.subtitle: Four documents pinned by hotspots to the parts of the PW skid they cover
components.summary: DocHotspots pins the documents delivered with a system to the parts of the skid they cover, so the reader sees what each record is about on the equipment itself.

components.name: DocList
components.subtitle: Documents as a hairline list: code in mono, name, detail; key documents first, code in flow; one link to the full index
components.summary: DocList shows the documents delivered with a system as a quiet hairline list: each row gives the short code a validation team files the document under, its name and one line of detail, with the deciding documents first and their code in `flow`.

components.name: DocPipe
components.subtitle: Pretreatment documents along one snaking double-line pipe
components.summary: DocPipe sets a short document list along one double-line pipe that snakes across a navy band: the route is the list, each document sits in its own bend with a valve on its run.

components.name: EvidenceMap
components.subtitle: Requirement, how we meet it, file chips or clause references
components.summary: EvidenceMap maps each requirement or standard to how we meet it and the documents that prove it, drawn as a mapping with leader lines and file-shaped chips, for the validation lead asking "where is the proof?".

components.name: Explainer
components.subtitle: One idea as a token-drawn figure plus numbered callouts: endotoxin margin
components.summary: Explainer sets out one idea as a figure plus three or four short numbered callouts instead of paragraphs, for a mechanism a reader should see at a glance (endotoxin margin set by the feed, what an upgrade costs in requalification).

components.name: ExplodedService
components.subtitle: Home: service promises as callouts on an exploded pump, on a light drawing sheet
components.summary: ExplodedService pins a few service promises to an exploded view of the part that service keeps running: a centrifugal pump drawn apart along its shaft on a light drawing sheet, with a leader from three of its parts to the promises.

components.name: FAQ
components.subtitle: Question rows under the outline counter, five questions all closed
components.summary: FAQ answers the questions engineers and QA ask before they call, as question rows under a large outline counter: index, question and a square +/− key, with the answer opening under the question.

components.name: FaultList
components.subtitle: Failure modes that open to cause and design control
components.summary: FaultList lists where things fail and what we design against; each failure opens to its cause and the design control.

components.name: FidelityLadder
components.subtitle: Design stages as one drawing gaining detail, sheet by sheet, with hold-point stamps
components.summary: FidelityLadder shows design stages as one drawing gaining detail on a navy blueprint band: every stage is a sheet with the same water package drawn at that stage's level (matrix, block route, P&ID, dimensioned isometric, frozen isometric, spools with their joints), joined by a run with a node per stage and a closed valve and "Hold point" stamp where you sign.

components.name: GradeEditorial
components.subtitle: Your first PW system as an editorial spread: navy mast, pipe collage, grade words set huge
components.summary: GradeEditorial sets a short path (a grid block of about five items) as an editorial spread: the heading oversized on a navy mast, a geometric pipe collage facing asymmetric fact blocks whose key words (a grade, a span, a figure) are set huge.

components.name: GradeLanes
components.subtitle: Minimum water grade by step, on three lanes
components.summary: GradeLanes shows the minimum water grade step by step: each step drops a tap into one of three lanes, Potable, PW and WFI.

components.name: GradeMains
components.subtitle: Eight dosage forms dropping to the water mains they take: potable, PW, WFI (dashed, not supplied)
components.summary: GradeMains draws a grade table as water mains on a navy blueprint: one horizontal main per water grade, each product or process step dropping a line to the main(s) it takes water from, with a valve at every tap.

components.name: GradeSwitch
components.subtitle: Natural health products on a selector panel: the knob in the minimum water, open slots where your specification may ask for PW
components.summary: GradeSwitch sets a short grade table as a selector panel: one strip per product, a selector with one slot per water grade, the knob in the minimum and a dashed open slot where your specification may call for more.

components.name: Hero
components.subtitle: Five heroes: home loop drawing, hub index, system equipment drawing, drawn binder and drawn route figures
components.summary: Hero opens every page: eyebrow, one display headline, one lead sentence, one primary button and one link.

components.name: HirePath
components.subtitle: How we hire: four steps on one path
components.summary: HirePath sets the steps into a role as one path walked left to right: a single track across the section, each step standing on it as a huge light numeral with its name and line under it, and the exercises a step tests drawn as a row of line icons.

components.name: HmiTrend
components.subtitle: Alarm lines as the operator panel's own dark screen: a trend against the limits, the drift flagged, the alarm summary
components.summary: HmiTrend sets a table of alarm lines (line, how it is set, what the system does) as the operator panel's own screen: a dark instrument panel with a trend plot of one reading under the limit lines, flagged by the trend rule before it reaches any of them, and the alarm summary as the real table.

components.name: HoldTimeline
components.subtitle: Services: six stages on a rising line over a macro weld; hold points ringed, PQ as the boxed figure
components.summary: HoldTimeline draws a sequence of stages with hold points as nodes on one rising line across a pale engraved macro close-up of a fused pipe joint, each stage's duration and deliverables hung off its node.

components.name: IndustryFeed
components.subtitle: Home: one water line teeing into three industries, each standard set large as the evidence
components.summary: IndustryFeed sets a few destinations of the same water as editorial type: one twin-wall pipe enters from the page edge and tees down into each column, where the destination's evidence (its standard) is the hero type.

components.name: IssuedSet
components.subtitle: The documents you receive as an issued set of sheets dealt onto a desk, stamped with the step that uses them
components.summary: IssuedSet shows the documents you receive as the issued set itself, dealt onto a desk: each document a sheet of paper at a slight turn with its code large, a miniature of what it looks like, its name and text, and a round stamp of the qualification step that uses it.

components.name: JointMacro
components.subtitle: The fabrication standard beside a traced duotone macro of a pipe end; a row moves the crop frame to its part
components.summary: JointMacro sets a standard beside a traced duotone macro close-up of the thing it governs: the end of a polypropylene pipe fills the left of a navy band, its contours traced in a hairline and numbered to the rows at the right.

components.name: JointSpine
components.subtitle: The joint log as rows hanging off a pipe: each row level with its joint on the spine
components.summary: JointSpine shows a log as rows hanging off a pipe: a twin-wall pipe drops in beside the title, bends and runs down the log as its spine, and each row sits level with a numbered joint on it.

components.name: JointSteps
components.subtitle: From pipe to turnover, told on one joint: navy title column, the joint sheet, the step rail with HP/WP codes
components.summary: JointSteps tells a fabrication sequence on one joint: a navy title column, a drawing sheet with the joint drawn large in isometric, and the steps on a numbered rail with hold point (HP) and witness point (WP) codes; as the rail is read, the sheet shows what that step does to the joint.

components.name: LayerStack
components.subtitle: Huge title on navy cropped by a limestone sheet holding the exploded stack of control layers
components.summary: LayerStack shows the layers of one system (field instruments up to the plant network) as an exploded isometric stack of machined plates, each carrying its equipment, with the labels on leaders from the plate corners.

components.name: LimitBento
components.subtitle: Purified Water limits as a bento: one oversized numeral per tile, a navy water column filled to the stricter value
components.summary: LimitBento sets a page's water-quality limits as a bento of tiles, one limit per tile with its value as an oversized Geist Mono numeral, around a tall navy water column that is filled to the stricter limit with the looser pharmacopoeia value marked high above it.

components.name: LimitStack
components.subtitle: Purified Water limits as a stepped type stack beside the outlet pipe and its Guaranteed collar
components.summary: LimitStack sets a page's water-quality limits as an editorial type stack beside a sculpted outlet pipe, so the reader sees each limit large, its reference, and the guaranteed skid-outlet value as the stack's last, boxed step.

components.name: LinkGrid
components.subtitle: Six services as linked rows: index, title, one line, standard tag, drawing
components.summary: LinkGrid sets out a list of choices (services, industries, systems, upgrade types) as rows of the shared list grammar: index, title with an arrow when it links, one line, an optional standard tag, and the linked page's icon at the row end on desktop.

components.name: LoopCircuit
components.subtitle: PW storage and distribution loop as one P&ID strip, a station over each caption
components.summary: LoopCircuit draws how a storage and distribution loop works as one blueprint P&ID strip on a navy band, each station standing over its own numbered caption, under a display-scale headline.

components.name: LoopDock
components.subtitle: Loop options on a navy band, leaders to captions on limestone
components.summary: LoopDock shows a loop's options where they fit on the loop: one isometric storage and distribution loop on a full-width navy band, a numbered marker on the part each option adds and a leader from it down to the option's caption on the limestone below.

components.name: MacroLeaders
components.subtitle: Grade, limit and inspector by industry, called out from a macro drawing of membrane leaves and a PP weld
components.summary: MacroLeaders sets a comparison table beside a macro drawing (RO membrane leaves fanned over a PP pipe and its weld bead) and calls each row out from it with a numbered marker and a leader, so a by-industry table reads as one piece of equipment serving every row.

components.name: ManifoldRouter
components.subtitle: Home: seven situations as branches off one manifold, the open route on a raised sheet
components.summary: ManifoldRouter sets a router table as large type on a limestone sheet, every situation a branch off one manifold: the reader picks a situation, the water runs down to its branch and its route opens beside it.

components.name: MarketCallouts
components.subtitle: Adjacent uses as callouts around one PW package drawn as a solid object on navy
components.summary: MarketCallouts shows several markets served by one machine: a single PW package drawn with IsoKit stands centred on a navy ground as a solid limestone object, and each option is a callout around it with a leader to the part its note is about.

components.name: MarkingMatch
components.subtitle: Supplier control as the receiving check: part marking, check line, certificate
components.summary: MarkingMatch shows supplier control as the receiving check an auditor would watch: each supply drawn as the part that arrives with its marking ringed in flow, the requirement on a certificate paper, and between them a double-ended check line carrying how we verify it.

components.name: MembraneAtlas
components.subtitle: Feed water conditions as a numbered table with navy numeral tiles
components.summary: MembraneAtlas reads a feed-water table as a numbered sequence of membrane failures: each row headed by a navy tile with a huge light slash numeral over a micrograph of what that condition does to the membrane, then the condition, its effect and what we design for.

components.name: MembraneFace
components.subtitle: RO feed targets as a bento round the feed end of a spiral-wound RO element
components.summary: MembraneFace sets a short list of feed-water targets as a bento round the thing they protect: the feed end of a spiral-wound reverse osmosis element, drawn large on navy, with one target per tile around it.

components.name: MethodBento
components.subtitle: Sanitization methods as a bento, hot-water rail with a probe
components.summary: MethodBento sets a short comparison of methods as a bento of drawn tiles, one per method, with the method that is not offered shown as an empty dashed tile.

components.name: ModulePlinth
components.subtitle: Six redundancy options as modules on the shared site loop's plinth, numbered cards beside
components.summary: ModulePlinth draws an options block with a base as modules standing on that base: an isometric plinth on a navy blueprint carries one block per option, each fed by a riser from the loop along the plinth, with numbered cards beside it.

components.name: NotesRegister
components.subtitle: Planned notes as a revision register, filtered by topic
components.summary: NotesRegister lists technical notes as a register table: date, note number, topic, title and standard, with topic filter chips and the latest or next planned note in a quiet panel beside it.

components.name: NumeralIndex
components.subtitle: Five situations as a Swiss index under huge outline numerals, each with its start page
components.summary: NumeralIndex sets a router table as a Swiss index of situations, each under a huge light outline numeral with its start page as a square go-cell, so a reader finds their situation by scanning large type rather than a table.

components.name: OptionChecker
components.subtitle: Options as a Swiss grid beside a checkerboard field with one blueprint tile
components.summary: OptionChecker sets an options block as a Swiss grid: a checkerboard field of navy, limestone and sunken squares with one navy blueprint tile of the control system, beside the section title set large and the options as cells under huge light slash numerals.

components.name: OptionList
components.subtitle: Options as hairline rows; decisions with a ? and a fork mark, one linked to the page that holds it
components.summary: OptionList shows the configuration choices for a system as rows of the shared list grammar: index, option name and one line on what it does.

components.name: OptionModules
components.subtitle: System options as modules wired to the base skid drawing
components.summary: OptionModules draws a system's equipment options as modules around the page's own equipment drawing (the base skid), each wired to it by a dashed hairline; it is the `as: "modules"` shape of the options block (OptionList).

components.name: OptionTags
components.subtitle: Five PW skid options as shipping tags, a round tag and folders on a limestone table
components.summary: OptionTags lays a system's configuration options out as physical tags on a limestone table, so each option reads as a separate item the buyer can add to the base skid.

components.name: OptionTaps
components.subtitle: Pretreatment options on a limestone drawing sheet with notes
components.summary: OptionTaps shows options where they would join the system, as one limestone drawing sheet: the standard train drawn solid in isometric line, each option a dashed part (the drawing convention for "optional") on its own dashed tee off the main line, a huge light title, and the options as numbered drawing notes in a narrow column whose numbers frame their part on the drawing.

components.name: PackMatrix
components.subtitle: One pack per client and period: a matrix of packs, one pulled out and opened to its six documents
components.summary: PackMatrix draws a docs block that is issued again and again (one pack per client and period) as that repetition: a matrix of identical packs, one pulled out and opened beside it as a sheet of its documents.

components.name: ParamTiles
components.subtitle: Ten skid design parameters as numbered Swiss tiles with a blueprint cell
components.summary: ParamTiles sets a system's design parameters as a Swiss grid of numbered tiles with one blueprint cell of the skid, so each parameter reads as its own panel and the whole grid scans at a glance.

components.name: ParameterCallouts
components.subtitle: Skid design parameters called out on the equipment drawing, the rest folded below
components.summary: ParameterCallouts lays a system's design parameters on its own equipment drawing, with leader lines from numbered labels to the part each one is about.

components.name: PdfAnatomy
components.subtitle: Delivery terms as a figure plate of the delivered PDF, callouts on leaders
components.summary: PdfAnatomy sets delivery terms as a figure plate of the delivered document: a PDF open in a viewer (bookmark pane, a search hit, the number and revision box in the footer of every page of the stack) with each part of the highlighted row's value as a callout on a leader, and the other rows beside it as signature lines or a large statement.

components.name: PidRoutes
components.subtitle: Router table drawn as a P&ID on navy: five situations piped through valves to a system and a start
components.summary: PidRoutes draws a router table (situation, system, start with) as a P&ID on a navy blueprint ground: each situation is piped through its own valve to its system and on to where to start, and rows that share a destination page are tied by a header line.

components.name: PipeCollage
components.subtitle: Engineering standards as a Swiss poster: a geometric collage, one numbered piece per standard, editorial blocks on brackets
components.summary: PipeCollage sets an evidence table as a Swiss poster: a geometric collage of flat pieces, one numbered piece per standard (a pressure vessel, a control panel, a flanged elbow, resin pellets, a fused joint) among plain filler tiles, beside the rows as asymmetric editorial blocks hung from hairline brackets.

components.name: PlanSheets
components.subtitle: Service plans as calibration sheets side by side on navy, terms read across
components.summary: PlanSheets compares service plans like calibration sheets laid side by side on a navy band: each plan a limestone sheet with a ruled scale strip, a huge light sheet number, the plan name, who it suits set large, its terms as ruled fields and its own button.

components.name: PqCalendar
components.subtitle: C&Q: PQ phases beside the 336-sample readout, grid and year scale
components.summary: PqCalendar sets PQ phases as a short numbered stack beside one instrument readout: the sample count as a giant light numeral, the sampling grid that makes it and a tick scale of the year (look `pq-calendar`, steps block).

components.name: ProcessDiagram
components.subtitle: PW skid treatment train as an line-art piping flow: stations are toggles, the pipe tints up to the selected one and its detail opens
components.summary: ProcessDiagram draws a treatment train as an interactive piping flow in single-weight line art: each stage is a station with its equipment vignette, joined by one double-hairline `flow` pipe with arrows, and choosing a station tints the pipe up to it and opens that stage's detail.

components.name: ProcessSteps
components.subtitle: Steps as numbered rows (a row may link to the page that holds that step), or a line-art hold flow
components.summary: ProcessSteps shows a real sequence (a project, a qualification, a service visit) as rows of the shared list grammar: index, step name and what happens.

components.name: ProjectRun
components.subtitle: Home: five project steps down one run, each with its equipment drawing (live: sticky stage, water fills with scroll)
components.summary: ProjectRun tells ordered steps as one run the reader scrolls along: on wide screens a sticky stage shows the current step's equipment drawing, its number set huge and a pipe whose water fills stop by stop as the steps scroll past.

components.name: ProofFolders
components.subtitle: Pharmacopoeias as a drawer of manila folders: typed slip, clipped proof sheets struck with a stamp, navy index label
components.summary: ProofFolders shows an evidence table as a drawer of manila folders, one per standard: the standard set large beside its folder, what we design to typed on a slip, the proof as clipped sheets struck with a stamp of the standard's code, and where we show it as the folder's navy index label.

components.name: Prose
components.subtitle: Heading left; a large light lead, then the paragraphs
components.summary: Prose is running text in a SplitSection: the heading on the left, the first sentence as a large light lead, then the paragraphs in body size, with white space and nothing else around them.

components.name: ReaderSplit
components.subtitle: Auditors on the navy half, what they read on the limestone half, across one seam
components.summary: ReaderSplit sets an evidence table on a band split down the middle: the readers (auditors, inspectors) on the navy half, what each reads and where we answer it across the seam on the limestone half, row against row.

components.name: Readout
components.subtitle: One limit as the page's highlighted figure: the WFI endotoxin limit from the home page
components.summary: Readout sets the page's one highlighted figure: the number large in Geist Mono Light in `flow` with its unit, the method on a limit tag, and a short caption.

components.name: RecordAnatomy
components.subtitle: What a published figure carries: a specimen record in four zones with leaders
components.summary: RecordAnatomy explains what a published record carries by drawing the anatomy of one specimen record: a limestone sheet in zones, one small drawing per part of the record, each zone's number led across the gutter to the point that explains it.

components.name: RecordSlips
components.subtitle: Each process and the record slip it feeds out of its slot
components.summary: RecordSlips shows each process of a quality system with the record it leaves: the process set large and light, what it controls under it, and at its right edge a slot from which a paper slip feeds out listing the records you can inspect, each with an empty tick box.

components.name: RedlineSheet
components.subtitle: P&ID band with each failure pinned, over three design-review markups on one sheet
components.summary: RedlineSheet shows qualification failures that start in design as design-review markups on one limestone drawing sheet: each failure is a column with its revision triangle, a small drawing of the design with the mistake ringed by a revision cloud, the mistake struck through and the correction drawn in flow as the markup note.

components.name: RelatedLinks
components.subtitle: Four next pages as tiles hung off one pipe: drawings for system pages
components.summary: RelatedLinks closes a page with the pages to read next as tiles hung off one pipe: each tile shows its index and section, a picture of the target page and its title with a `flow` arrow.

components.name: ReleaseRun
components.subtitle: Four tech-transfer steps as Swiss columns under one water line, the release column navy
components.summary: ReleaseRun sets ordered steps as Swiss columns under one water line: a huge light numeral per step, a node where each step starts, and the last step as the navy column where the water is released.

components.name: ResponseClock
components.subtitle: Fault steps read off a stopwatch dial
components.summary: ResponseClock tells what happens when something goes wrong as a response clock: a large stopwatch dial with one numbered station per step around its rim, a running arc from the step that starts the clock, and the steps listed beside it with huge light numbers.

components.name: ResponseLanes
components.subtitle: Response times by request as lanes on one clock: severities 1 to 4 under huge light numerals, then the other requests; every clause a stop with its placeholder clock
components.summary: ResponseLanes draws a table of response times by request as lanes on one clock: each request runs from where you call or send through its first response into what follows, every clause a stop with its time beneath, and the severities set as a calm scale of huge light numerals.

components.name: RetrofitPlant
components.subtitle: Upgrades on the running plant: existing faint, the sheet moves in on the new work
components.summary: RetrofitPlant shows common upgrades on the running plant the way a retrofit drawing does: the existing plant faint on a navy blueprint, the stages an upgrade changes lit, and the upgrades as a tab list with the picked one's terms beside it.

components.name: ReturnSlips
components.subtitle: What each request returns: each situation set large, a pipe across, and the returned items dealt out as paper slips with When and Cost
components.summary: ReturnSlips sets a table of what each request returns as an exchange on a limestone band: each situation large on the left, a pipe across, and what comes back dealt out as paper slips with their "When" and "Cost" fields.

components.name: ReviewReticles
components.subtitle: Assessment areas framed in inspection viewfinders
components.summary: ReviewReticles frames each area an assessment reviews in an inspection viewfinder: corner brackets, a crosshair and the index around an IsoKit drawing of the thing reviewed, the area's name set large under it.

components.name: RevisionRegister
components.subtitle: The notes register as a revision register sheet
components.summary: RevisionRegister keeps technical notes the way a drawing office keeps its revision register: one limestone register sheet on a navy band, topic tabs in its title strip, the lead note set as an editorial page beside ruled register lines.

components.name: RevisionSheet
components.subtitle: One document taking each review step's marks, pinned beside the steps
components.summary: RevisionSheet tells a document review cycle on one document: a paper sheet stays pinned beside the steps and takes each step's marks as the step reaches the middle of the screen (comments, answered comments and a struck draft tag, signatures, recorded data, the current revision), its revision block filling one row per step.

components.name: RoleMatrix
components.subtitle: Who writes and who reviews, as signature stamps
components.summary: RoleMatrix shows who writes, does and approves each document, like the signature blocks on a controlled document, so the split between our work and your sign-off is visible at a glance.

components.name: Router
components.subtitle: Pick your situation, see one route; pending stations dashed
components.summary: Router lets a buyer pick the situation they are in and see one route through what follows: the water they need, the system, and where to start with us.

components.name: RuleFigures
components.subtitle: Seven PW loop design rules, each with its engineering figure; turbulent flow as the lead
components.summary: RuleFigures sets a spec block of design rules as a Swiss rule sheet in which every rule is explained by a small engineering figure, the lead rule as a full-width band beside a pipe cut open to show turbulent flow.

components.name: SectionTrain
components.subtitle: The pretreatment train as one sectional elevation, each bed holding what it caught
components.summary: SectionTrain draws a pretreatment train as one sectional elevation on a limestone sheet, every vessel cut open so its bed shows and each bed holding what it caught, so the reader sees the water lose its particles, hardness, chlorine and fines stage by stage.

components.name: SheetStack
components.subtitle: Four loop documents as an exploded stack of drawing sheets
components.summary: SheetStack shows the documents delivered with a system as an exploded stack of isometric drawing sheets, each sheet drawing in miniature what the document is, its row beside it.

components.name: ShopFloor
components.subtitle: The people you would work with, at their stations on the shop plan
components.summary: ShopFloor places the company's people or roles where their work happens, as numbered stations on one isometric plan of the shop with a walking route through them, so a reader sees the shop and who works where before reading the cards.

components.name: SignalDial
components.subtitle: Signals table beside a multi-channel transmitter dial: pick a row or turn the dial
components.summary: SignalDial sets a spec block of signals as the instrument schedule (the real table) beside one multi-channel transmitter dial whose bezel turns to the chosen signal and reads it out: channel number large and light, the signal's name, a limit line, the design value and the basis on an outlined tag.

components.name: SignatureBlocks
components.subtitle: C&Q: who writes and who reviews as signature blocks; the reviewer signs
components.summary: SignatureBlocks sets a roles table (who writes, who reviews) as the signature block at the foot of each document, the party in each field shown by its box (look `signature-blocks`, table block `as: "roles"`).

components.name: SitePlates
components.subtitle: Where to find us: each site a figure plate with its isometric drawing, the kind set large, address and contact lines; two shown, the rest folded
components.summary: SitePlates sets a table of sites (site, what happens here, address, contact and hours) as figure plates, two to a row, each with an isometric drawing of what stands there, the kind of site set large and light, and its address and contact lines.

components.name: SiteTiles
components.subtitle: What changes for a Canadian site: four tiles, each opened by a figure plate
components.summary: SiteTiles sets a short grid of what changes for a site as a Swiss row of tiles, each opened by a small flat figure plate that draws the change instead of naming it, then the number large and light, the title, the line and its link.

components.name: SparesKit
components.subtitle: Like-for-like rules on a spares tray, one pocket per part
components.summary: SparesKit reads like-for-like rules off the spares kit: a tray (a shadow board seen from above) with one pocket per part, each part drawn flat in line art in its cut-out, and under it the answers: "=" like for like when, "≠" a change when, "→" what follows a change.

components.name: SpineShelf
components.subtitle: Turnover package as binder spines on a shelf beside its index that opens
components.summary: SpineShelf shows a document package as the object itself: a row of binder spines standing on one shelf (one per section, each as thick as the section holds documents, the key section navy) beside the package index, whose sections open to list their documents.

components.name: SpoolDossier
components.subtitle: The fabrication dossier beside the as-built isometric spool it indexes; a part shows its layer
components.summary: SpoolDossier sets a document set beside the as-built isometric it indexes: the title huge and light at the top left, an isometric polypropylene spool at the right with numbered joints and lot-tagged lengths, and the documents in a hairline grid under them.

components.name: StageStacks
components.subtitle: What each stage issues: sheets stacked on the project axis, navy ground
components.summary: StageStacks draws what each project stage issues as the document file building up: the stages stand on one project axis, each stage's documents stacked above it as sheets of paper, its name, clause and who approves under the axis.

components.name: StageTiles
components.subtitle: C&Q: stages as navy and limestone tiles with slash numerals; the IQ tile carries the pipe drawing
components.summary: StageTiles sets ordered stages as a Swiss row of navy and limestone tiles, each led by a huge light slash numeral, with the heading in a navy band over them (look `stage-tiles`, steps block).

components.name: StairRouter
components.subtitle: Services: seven situations as a rising stair of cards over outline type, Go on the limestone wedge
components.summary: StairRouter draws a router table ("which situation are you in, where do you start") as a rising staircase of situation cards over huge cropped outline type, every route open at once.

components.name: StandardTiles
components.subtitle: Four systems as tall Swiss tiles, the standard tag set as the hero
components.summary: StandardTiles sets a short grid of linked items as a Swiss row of tall tiles where each item's standard or control tag is the hero, large in Geist Mono Light, with the item's icon, title and line under it.

components.name: StandardWires
components.subtitle: Standards on a navy blueprint, each answer wired to the equipment that answers it
components.summary: StandardWires sets a table of standards on a navy blueprint and wires each answer to the equipment that answers it, so a reader who starts from a standard sees which part of the system meets it.

components.name: StandardsGrid
components.subtitle: The twelve standards on the home page, code only, on hairlines
components.summary: StandardsGrid lists the standards Aquemi designs to as a numbered three-column grid on `line` hairlines, as a section of its own under a large headline.

components.name: StandardsMap
components.subtitle: Zones of the water system on one pipe, each labelled with the standards that govern it
components.summary: StandardsMap is a plant map of the water system: each zone (generation, storage and distribution, pure steam, controls and data, fabrication, qualification) is a hairline-framed area labelled with the standards that govern it, and every code jumps to the row further down the page that proves it.

components.name: StandardsOrbit
components.subtitle: Standards as nodes on orbit rings round the PW plant; each zone arcs in to the part it governs, its codes jump to their proof
components.summary: StandardsOrbit draws a standards map as orbits round the plant: the Purified Water plant in isometric line art in the middle of a navy band, two elliptical rings round it, and each zone of the system a node on the outer ring with its standards beside it and an arc running in to the part that zone governs.

components.name: StrataRun
components.subtitle: One water run down a terrace of paper slabs: six stages from feed water to points of use, each label leading to its equipment
components.summary: StrataRun draws a process diagram as one water run stepping down a terrace of stacked paper slabs, so the reader sees the whole package from feed water to points of use as a single route through real equipment.

components.name: StrikeGaps
components.subtitle: Gaps struck through, requirement on the arrow, the fix set large
components.summary: StrikeGaps sets gaps and their fixes as a before and after in large light type: the gap as it stands, struck through like a drawing revision; the requirement it misses in mono on an arrow; what the upgrade does at full strength.

components.name: SuiteLoop
components.subtitle: Five situations as suites fed from one shared loop, each with its start page as the way out
components.summary: SuiteLoop draws a router table as a plan of one shared loop serving a row of suites: every situation is a room fed by its own drop and valve off the loop, with the start page as the room's way out.

components.name: SystemRun
components.subtitle: Home: the package as one water line through pretreatment, PW generation, storage and monitoring, a navy blueprint
components.summary: SystemRun shows a modular package as one continuous water line drawn as a navy blueprint: drinking water enters at the left, runs through each system's equipment in order and leaves at the point of use, with a column per system under the drawing.

components.name: TankTiles
components.subtitle: Tank and pipework on a navy and limestone checkerboard, one blueprint tile
components.summary: TankTiles sets a spec block's parameters on a Swiss checkerboard of square navy and limestone tiles, each led by a huge light slash numeral, with one steel-blue blueprint tile of the storage tank as the anchor.

components.name: TermsSheet
components.subtitle: Commercial terms as a contract's terms sheet
components.summary: TermsSheet sets commercial terms as a contract's terms sheet: one paper sheet with a ruled head, the terms as numbered clauses in two columns, each with its number large and light, the term, our side of it one value per line, and its note.

components.name: TestSheet
components.subtitle: FAT and SAT: the protocol as a signed test sheet, hold points stamped, SAT torn off
components.summary: TestSheet sets ordered steps as the protocol's own test sheet lying on a limestone table: ruled rows, tick boxes, signed and stamped hold points, the last step torn off along a perforation (look `test-sheet`, steps block).

components.name: TimeCard
components.subtitle: Pay, benefits and terms as the shop's time card
components.summary: TimeCard sets a spec block of working terms as the shop's time card: a limestone card with its hang hole, a column header, one ruled line per term with a punch slot and number, and the block's note stamped at its foot, so pay and terms read as the paper a person on the floor handles each week.

components.name: ToleranceScales
components.subtitle: Calibration acceptance as bands on rulers, figures large
components.summary: ToleranceScales reads instrument calibration as acceptance bands: each instrument a row with its name and basis, and one readout per check with the acceptance set large and a ruler showing the nominal line and the band between the limits.

components.name: TraceLines
components.subtitle: Two requirements as transit lines beside a readout tile of the traced limit
components.summary: TraceLines shows a traceability table as transit lines: each requirement is a line that starts at its code, set large, and runs down through one station per document, with a dashed pass where a document does not answer it and test-step chips branching off where a document names its tests.

components.name: UrsGate
components.subtitle: Five decisions along the project line, before the URS approval gate
components.summary: UrsGate sets decisions that must be made before a gate as one project line running into that gate: decisions stand on stems above and below the line with huge light numerals, and the gate is a bar with its word as giant outline type cut by the page edge.

components.name: Versus
components.subtitle: Two routes across a spine of factors, with a verdict or a conclusion band
components.summary: Versus sets two routes face to face across a spine of factors, for a buyer choosing one of two (hot or ambient WFI, multi-effect or vapour compression).

components.name: VersusSpread
components.subtitle: FAT and SAT: an editorial spread, the comparison table beside one drawing of the installed system with the test bay and site boundaries
components.summary: VersusSpread sets a FAT versus SAT table as an editorial spread: a navy mast with the heading at display scale, the numbered comparison table, and one line drawing of the installed system whose parts light for the test being read (look `versus-spread`, table block `as: "versus"`).

components.name: VisitPlan
components.subtitle: A service visit walked around the plant: numbered stops on a dashed route
components.summary: VisitPlan shows a service visit as a route around the system: the whole PW plant in IsoKit line art on a limestone drawing sheet, the technician's walk as a dashed route on the floor in front of it with a numbered stop at each part the visit checks, and one card per stop under the sheet.

components.name: VisitRoute
components.subtitle: A preventive maintenance visit as numbered stops on one route, ending in sign-off
components.summary: VisitRoute lays a visit's checks out as numbered stops on one route line drawn on a Plate, each stop a line drawing of the equipment it covers, for a walk-round whose order matters, such as what a preventive maintenance visit covers, ending at the sign-off.

components.name: WalkdownPins
components.subtitle: C&Q: IQ and OQ checks as a table beside the installed system, numbers and callouts on the parts
components.summary: WalkdownPins sets IQ and OQ checks as a table beside the installed system they inspect, each check's number on its part and a few parts called out by name (look `walkdown-pins`, spec block).

components.name: WasherTrace
components.subtitle: The washer drawing with the water route through three numbered points
components.summary: WasherTrace tells an explainer as the water's way into a machine: the page's equipment drawing stays pinned on a navy band while the points scroll past, each point a numbered hotspot on the drawing, the water route filling hotspot to hotspot as you read.

components.name: WaterPath
components.subtitle: Seven system families as stations on one pipe; the selected family opens its line, standard and link
components.summary: WaterPath shows the system families as stations on one pipe, from city feed to point of use, so the reader sees how the systems connect and can open each one's line, standard and page from the drawing.

components.name: WetRunHmi
components.subtitle: FAT and SAT: the explainer read along the test bay water route, dry check or with water
components.summary: WetRunHmi sets an explainer as the test bay's water route on a navy blueprint ground: one double-wall pipe runs across the section and folds down and back up, each point sits beside its station, and a two-position switch runs the skid dry or with water (look `wet-run-hmi`, prose block `as: "explainer"`).

components.name: WindingRoute
components.subtitle: Seven treatment stages as stops on one winding pipe across a navy band
components.summary: WindingRoute draws a treatment train as one winding pipe across a navy band, each stage a stop on the wave with its line glyph, so the reader follows the water stage by stage.

components.name: WitnessPlan
components.subtitle: FAT and SAT: ways to witness as rows whose leaders run into the package in the test bay
components.summary: WitnessPlan sets the ways to witness a FAT as ruled rows whose leader lines run into the package standing in the test bay; choosing a way lights its leader, marker and part (look `witness-plan`, options block).

components.name: CompareTable
components.subtitle: Start from your water grade: four grades against standard and limits, with a link column
components.summary: CompareTable sets three or more options against criteria as a hairline matrix, with sentence-case column heads on `surface-sunken`, numbered row labels in a narrow left column and, on phones, one record per row (or column tabs for wide tables) instead of a sideways scroll.

components.name: KeyFacts
components.subtitle: Aquemi's own figures, each with its unit and basis, as a quiet strip between hairlines (home, sys-storage and contact-service, placeholders until confirmed)
components.summary: KeyFacts is a strip of up to four of Aquemi's own figures, each with its unit and the basis a reader can hold us to, that tells an engineer what a page stands on before they read a word of copy.

components.name: LimitGauges
components.subtitle: Release limits as dials; design rules as threshold bars, a row linking where it is set; two limits two across, the action level named as one
components.summary: LimitGauges shows a block of water or steam quality limits as quiet instrument faces on a plate, one dial per limit, so a reader sees at a glance where each limit sits and which side of it passes.

components.name: PlanTiers
components.subtitle: Service plans side by side: who each suits, price, terms, one action per plan
components.summary: PlanTiers compares service plans in one table on a plate: numbered terms down the left, one column per plan, a "Fits when" row and one action per plan, for a buyer choosing a plan tier.

components.name: SpecTable
components.subtitle: WFI spec sheet with the critical limit as a readout band, and a comparison table
components.summary: Specification sheets present water quality limits as a two-column matrix with the one critical limit pulled out as a full-width band, the most persuasive content Aquemi has.

components.name: StandardTag
components.subtitle: Standards a system is designed to
components.summary: Standard tags name the regulation, pharmacopoeia or engineering code a system is built to.

components.name: EnquiryForm
components.subtitle: A numbered data sheet with its note under the submit; the stepped form's first step, with a note that sends supplier audits to their own form; an application step with a placeholder option chosen and a required upload left empty
components.summary: EnquiryForm lays out a proposal, service or application request as a numbered data sheet on a quiet panel: numbered sections, numbered items and one submit.

components.name: TextField
components.subtitle: Default, with unit, and error
components.summary: Text fields collect enquiry and service-request details.
